senate.canonical_url: strip the ?back= query string from the listing href
senate.guard: An unrecognized press slug returns HTTP 200 with the UNFILTERED chamber archive and an EMPTY <h1>. Require a non-empty <h1> matching /Press Releases/ before accepting any item.
senate.slug_warning: The press-page slug is NOT always the roster slug. Verified mismatches: mary-b-boren -> mary-b.-boren, dustydeevers -> dusty-deevers. Always read the /senator-press-releases/ href off the senator detail page.
senate.rss: https://www.oksenate.gov/rss.xml (10 items, chamber-wide; change-detection only, not a collection path)
senate.joint_releases: Per-member pages summed to 286 items dated 2026 while the chamber archive holds 267 unique -- the 19-item gap is joint releases listed on several senators' pages under one canonical URL. Same ON CONFLICT (source_url) collision as the House.

house.graphql_note: Open Strapi API, no auth. posts(filters:{published:{gte:...}}, sort:"published:desc", pagination:{page,pageSize}) returns title, slug, published, full HTML content, and a first-class members relation. Introspection is disabled.
house.html_fallback: https://www.okhouse.gov/news?member={slug} embeds the same records in __NEXT_DATA__ but returns only the 9 most recent plus totalPosts.
house.joint_releases: 36 of the 321 posts published 2026-01-01..2026-07-25 credit more than one member; 6 credit none. update.py's ON CONFLICT (source_url) DO NOTHING means a joint release lands on whichever member is collected first and is silently dropped for the rest. Oklahoma needs a many-to-many attribution path before load.
